en.headline: Civil servants to receive 12 hours of family care leave a year from January
en.dek: The Civil Service Bureau detailed the new entitlement in a paper to the Legislative Council panel, allowing flexible hourly leave for family matters with streamlined approval.
body: Hong Kong civil servants will be entitled to up to 12 hours of family care leave a year starting from January, the Civil Service Bureau said in a paper submitted to the Legislative Council's public service panel on Tuesday.

The initiative, first outlined in the September Policy Address, allows staff to use the leave to accompany family members to medical appointments, care for sick relatives, attend children’s school activities or handle household emergencies.

The bureau promised flexible and streamlined approval procedures as part of a people-orientated approach. Officials have previously said applications would be straightforward, with supervisors able to approve based on satisfaction even if supporting documents are limited at the time.
The leave is intended for short absences rather than full-day needs, which staff can still cover with other existing leave entitlements.

zh.headline: 公務員明年一月起每年可享12小時照顧家庭假
zh.dek: 公務員事務局向立法會事務委員會提交文件，詳細說明新假期安排，容許靈活按小時計假處理家庭事務，申請程序簡化。
body: 公務員事務局周二向立法會公務員及資助機構員工事務委員會提交文件，說明公務員將由明年一月起每年可享最多12小時照顧家庭假。
措施於九月施政報告首次提出，員工可用假期陪同家人求診、照顧患病親屬、出席子女學校活動或處理家庭緊急事項。
局方承諾以人為本方式提供靈活及簡化的審批程序。官員早前表示申請會十分簡便，即使當時未能提供充分證明，只要上司信納便可批准。
假期旨在應付短暫離崗需要，全日需要仍可使用其他現有假期。
